q: 1. Policy is
options: a rule or a set of rules never to be violated
a definite rule along which one has to proceed
a procedure for preparing the project report
a set of broad guidelines stipulated by management
explain: Policies serve as overarching guidelines established by executive management to direct decision-making and organizational actions.

q: 2. In a functional organization
options: specialised knowledge and guidance to individual worker is provided
explain: Specialisation gives better quality, less wastage and expert guidance.

q: 3. The salient feature of the organization evolved by F.W. Taylor is
options: separation of planning and design part for field work
explain: Taylor's functional organization separates planning from execution and relies on functional efficiency and strict specifications.

q: 4. Construction team means
explain: A construction team comprises the owner, engineer/architect, and contractor working together to complete the project.

q: 5. Military organisation is known as
explain: Military organizations follow a strict chain-of-command structure characteristic of line organization.

q: 6. The main advantage of line organization, is
explain: Line organization provides clear command, defined responsibilities, and strong discipline - all being its key advantages.

q: 7. Functional organization system of working was introduced by
explain: F. W. Taylor introduced functional organization.

q: 8. Power stations are generally treated as
explain: Power stations, involving heavy machinery and large-scale industrial processes, are classified under industrial construction.

q: 9. The construction of airport are treated as
explain: Airports are heavy construction.

q: 10. Military type of organization is known as
explain: Line organization follows a military-style chain of command.

q: 11. Types of organization used in construction industry is:
explain: Per the answer key, 'effective organization' is listed as the correct type, though line, line-staff, and functional organizations are the more standard classifications used in construction.

q: 12. The final technical authority of a project is
explain: The chief engineer is the final technical authority.

q: 13. Construction activities at site are associated with the management of
explain: Site construction activities require coordinated management of manpower, material, and machinery/equipment - all of the above.

q: 14. The types of format in which the records of labors are kept on daily basis for executing works is known as
explain: A muster roll is a specific document used in construction and public works to record the attendance of daily laborers and calculate their wages.

q: 15. Donor funded project are based on
explain: Donor-funded projects consider government priorities, user needs, and economic viability (IRR) - all of these factors.

q: 16. Which of the following excavators is most suitable for digging under water?
explain: A clam shell excavator, with its grab-bucket mechanism, is best suited for digging in submerged/underwater conditions.

q: 17. Frederick W. Taylor introduced a system of working known as
explain: F.W. Taylor, the father of Scientific Management, introduced functional foremanship where specialists lead specific functions.

q: 18. Construction activities at site are directly associated with the management of
explain: Field management integrates control over basic resources: Manpower, Machinery, and Materials (the 3 Ms of construction management).

q: 19. Project maintenance is:
explain: Project/facility maintenance continues throughout the operational life of the project as an ongoing process.

q: 20. Preventive maintenance is a types of
explain: Preventive maintenance is scheduled in advance (planned) to prevent equipment failure before it occurs.

q: 21. The conception of idea for any construction work is the responsibility of:
explain: but as per book b The owner originates the idea/need for a construction project, initiating the process before engineers or contractors get involved.

q: 22. Site order book is used for recording
explain: The site order book records instructions given by the executive engineer to site personnel/contractor.

q: 23. Preliminary project report for a road project must contain
options: the detailed estimated cost based on detailed design
the several alternatives of the project that have been considered
the soil survey, traffic survey, concept design and approximate cost
the contract documents for inviting tenders
explain: A preliminary report holds surveys, concept design and an approximate cost.

q: 24. A project is
options: a large dam constructed across a river for a single or multi-purpose
any job involving many people and large money
a work of major importance involving huge men and material
an organised team work to achieve a set task within the time limit
explain: A project is organised teamwork to achieve a set task within a time limit.

q: 25. Frederick W. Taylor introduced a system of working known as
explain: F.W. Taylor introduced functional organization, dividing work among specialized functional supervisors.

q: 26. A Work Breakdown Structure numbering system should allow project staff to
options: Identify the level at which individual WBS elements are found
Estimate the costs of WBS elements
explain: A WBS numbering system's primary purpose is to indicate the hierarchical level at which each element resides within the structure.

q: 27. For excavating utility trenches with precise control of depth, the excavation equipment used is
explain: A hoe (backhoe) gives precise depth control in trenches.

q: 28. The basic action involved in sheep foot rolling is
explain: Per the answer key, kneading. Note: many books say tamping.

q: 29. Major characteristics of project is
options: defined life span with a beginning and end
specific time, cost and performance requirement
explain: A project is characterized by a defined objective, a distinct life span, and specific time/cost/performance requirements - all of the above.
